### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Bryant-Li-Bhoj neurodevelopmental syndrome 2  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.500)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-9764725)

**Proposed mechanism:** TWIST2 (HGNC:12418) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837); Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837) —LEADS_TO→ Craniofacial abnormalities (HP:0000252); H3-3B (HGNC:4824) —DISRUPTS→ Histone modification and chromatin remodeling (GO:0016569); Histone modification and chromatin remodeling (GO:0016569) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental delay (HP:0001263); Histone modification and chromatin remodeling (GO:0016569) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Haploinsufficiency of TWIST2 disrupts epithelial-mesenchymal transition, leading to craniofacial abnormalities in focal facial dermal dysplasia type III. Concurrently, haploinsufficiency of H3-3B disrupts histone modification and chromatin remodeling, resulting in neurodevelopmental delay and intellectual disability in Bryant-Li-Bhoj neurodevelopmental syndrome 2. The convergence occurs at the level of chromatin regulation, where both genetic disruptions impact the precise control of gene expression necessary for proper development.

**How to falsify it:** Absence of significant overlap in affected developmental pathways or cellular processes between TWIST2 and H3-3B when examined through high-throughput omics studies in relevant cellular models. _(variant: None)_
